# Compiled Portal vector

`themed-vector-sdk37-no-namespaces.xmltree.txt` is a genuine AAPT2 xmltree dump,
not a fabricated Android resource adapter. Source: the approved
`drawable/themed_app_icon.xml` generated by `integrate-archium-portal.py`.

Generated with Android SDK37 AAPT2 v2.20-15087165 and Android36 framework jar:

```bash
aapt2 compile --dir res -o compiled.zip
aapt2 link --no-version-vectors --no-xml-namespaces --auto-add-overlay \
  -o vector.apk -I android.jar --manifest AndroidManifest.xml compiled.zip
aapt2 dump xmltree vector.apk --file res/drawable/themed_app_icon.xml
```

The two link flags and build-tools version match `build/android/gyp/compile_resources.py`
and `build/config/android/config.gni` at Chromium
`cfd94726b7b5fb48aedcc32662f2f3fbdbadec35`. The SDK36 framework supplies these
stable vector attributes; full Chromium framework37/merged-resource verification
remains a separate blocking postrestore gate. This fixture does not claim APK,
Chromium merge, JNI, Robolectric, or device validation.

Namespace stripping preserves framework attribute IDs. Acceptance requires both
the correct name and framework ID, then the complete approved vector content.
Foreign IDs/namespaces, changed transforms/path and unrecognized attributes fail.
The real AAPT2 integration test separately recompiles/links/optimizes PNG and
lossless WebP resources plus six altered vectors with the same link flags.
